git.branch.checkoutDetachedTip: No local branch is created; commits made here will not be referenced by any branch once you switch away
git.branch.dirtyConfirm.one:
There is {count} uncommitted change. Switching branches may fail or carry it into the target branch.
Stashing first (stash → checkout → auto-restore) is recommended.
git.branch.dirtyConfirm.other:
There are {count} uncommitted changes. Switching branches may fail or carry them into the target branch.
Stashing first (stash → checkout → auto-restore) is recommended.
git.branch.mergeNoFfTip: Create a merge commit even when fast-forward is possible
git.branch.mergeSquashTip: Squash every change from that branch into one pending commit
git.branch.nameChars: Branch name cannot contain spaces or \\ ~ ^ : ? * [ ]
git.branch.nameStart: Branch name cannot start with - or /
git.branch.rebaseConfirm: Rebase the current branch onto “{branch}”? Unpushed commits will be rewritten (their hashes change).
git.branch.rebaseTip: git rebase (linear history, rewrites unpushed commits)
git.branch.remoteGroup: Remote branches (click to check out locally and track)
git.branch.remoteTip: Remote branch — click to check out locally and track it
git.branch.statusNoUpstream: Current branch (click to switch) · no upstream
git.branch.statusTip: Current branch (click to switch) · upstream {upstream} · ↑{ahead} to push ↓{behind} to pull
git.conflict.applyEditConfirm: Overwrite “{path}” with the edited content and mark it resolved?
git.conflict.applyEditConfirmLong: Overwrite “{path}” with the edited content and mark it resolved?\nNote: choices made in the block panel will not apply (the edit overwrites the whole file).
git.conflict.noneHint: No recognizable conflict markers in this file
git.conflict.openFile: Open the file and resolve it manually
git.detail.noneHint: Click a commit under History in the Source Control panel for details (git show), or use Blame in the diff view to trace who changed each line
git.diff.stageHunkTip: Stage the hunk at the cursor
git.diff.unstageHunkTip: Unstage the hunk at the cursor
git.discard.confirmMany.one: Discard changes in {count} file? This cannot be undone.
git.discard.confirmMany.other: Discard changes in {count} files? This cannot be undone.
git.discard.confirmOne: Discard the unstaged changes in “{path}”? This cannot be undone.
git.discard.untrackedConfirm: “{path}” is untracked; discarding will delete the file.
git.history.cherryPickTip: {hash} · apply this commit's changes to the current branch
git.history.fileNone: This file has no commit history yet
git.history.revertConfirm: Create an inverse commit for “{subject}”? This adds a new commit (history is not rewritten).
git.history.resetTo: Reset the current branch to this commit…
git.hunk.cursorOutside: Cursor is not inside any hunk — move it to the line you want to act on
git.hunk.discardConfirm: Discard the current hunk in “{path}”? This cannot be undone.
git.hunk.noneInBase: No hunk-level changes under the current base (e.g. everything is already staged) — switch to the “all changes” base
git.hunk.untrackedGuide: “{path}” is untracked (never committed) — stage the whole file instead of using hunk actions
git.menu.commitAmendTip: Fold changes into the previous commit
git.menu.fetchPrune: Fetch and prune deleted remote branches
git.menu.formatTip: Run ruff format on staged Python files before committing (only files with a clean working tree)
git.menu.pushTip: Push the current branch to origin (set upstream)
git.menu.remoteTip: Add / remove / push to a specific remote
git.out.cherryPickFailed: cherry-pick failed (use --abort to give up on conflicts): {error}
git.out.mergeFailed: Merge failed (use git merge --abort to give up): {error}
git.out.rebaseFailed: Rebase conflicted or failed (use git rebase --abort to give up): {error}
git.out.revertFailed: revert failed (use --abort to give up on conflicts): {error}
git.out.stashPopRestoreFailed: Restore stash failed (the stash is still in the list): {error}
git.panel.initHint: Runs git init in the workspace root
git.panel.noWorkspaceHint: Git changes appear here once a workspace is open
git.panel.notRepoHint: Initialize a repository to enable source control
git.remote.listFailed: Failed to read the remote list
git.remote.noneHint: Add a remote to enable push and pull
git.remote.removeConfirm: Remove remote “{name}” ({url})? The remote repository itself is not affected.
git.remote.title: Remotes
git.reset.hard: Hard ⚠ uncommitted changes will be lost
git.reset.hardConfirm: A hard reset discards all uncommitted changes (cannot be undone). Continue?
git.reset.hardTip: {target} · resets HEAD, index and working tree
git.reset.mixedTip: {target} · moves HEAD and resets the index; changes stay in the working tree
git.reset.softTip: {target} · moves HEAD only; all changes return to the index
git.stash.dropConfirm: Drop stash@{{{index}}}? This cannot be undone.
git.stash.messageHint: Give this batch a note (leave empty to use git's default message)
git.stash.noneHint: Changes saved with git stash push appear here
git.stash.title: Stash changes
git.stash.viewDiffTip: View the diff of this stash
git.toast.checkedOut: Checked out as local branch {branch}, tracking {remote}
git.toast.fileNotInChanges: {path} is no longer in the change list; closing the diff view
git.toast.nothingStaged: Nothing staged — use + to stage the files you want to commit
git.toast.notInChanges: “{path}” is not in the Git change list
git.toast.pathCopied: Path copied — use File → Open Workspace to switch to this worktree
git.toast.reloadSkippedMany.one: {count} file has unsaved changes and was not reloaded from disk ({rest} others were refreshed)
git.toast.reloadSkippedMany.other: {count} files have unsaved changes and were not reloaded from disk ({rest} others were refreshed)
git.toast.reloadSkippedOne.one: “{file}” has unsaved changes and was not reloaded from disk ({count} other file was refreshed)
git.toast.reloadSkippedOne.other: “{file}” has unsaved changes and was not reloaded from disk ({count} other files were refreshed)
git.toast.remoteEmpty: Name and URL cannot both be empty
git.toast.switchedAndPopped: Switched branch and restored the stashed changes
git.toast.untrackedNoHistory: “{path}” is untracked (never committed); there is no commit history to trace
git.worktree.copyPathTip: Copy this worktree path and switch via File → Open Workspace
git.worktree.pathLabel: Path (relative to the repo root, e.g. ../myproj-feature)
git.worktree.removeConfirm: Remove “{path}”? Uncommitted changes in that directory are deleted too (cannot be undone).
git.worktree.title: Worktrees (parallel workspaces per branch)
